description: The source report combines life-cycle assessment, PESTEL analysis and expert input to evaluate pit thermal-storage construction, operation and end-of-life implications. It identifies charging heat production, land use, site selection and materials as relevant environmental parameters. This is source-defined environmental assessment information for thermal infrastructure. A reusable inventory table, independent executable and exact assessed sites are not identified by native metadata. Its pit-storage scope is kept distinct from the Linz tank case. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
